items.name: Yacht kit: hull loft, decks, houses, stairs, rails, PBR materials
Fleet of 10+ distinct original yachts (40 ft to 150 ft), each with name, builder, port, lore
Deck-by-deck interiors: salon, galley, dining, cabins, heads, engine room, crew, tender garage
Flybridge and helm with instruments, working wheel and throttles
Sundeck, loungers, working hot tub you can sit in
Food and drink you can eat aboard
Navigation, deck, underwater and interior lights
Music system audible across the water
Moving-platform physics: walk every deck, stair and rail while under way (no fall-through, no jitter)
Ship motion: displacement and semi-planing roll, pitch, slow turning, big wake
Mooring at marinas, anchoring offshore, cruising AI routes
Boarding: swim platform, tender, dock
Helm: ask the captain or take over by force; hang out (eat, hot tub, dance)
Scenario: party yacht
Scenario: rich family yacht (confrontation, police call, return to shore)
Scenario: crewed charter (booking check, security)
Helm takeover escalation (wanted stars, panic, overboard jump)
Captains, crew and guests as distinct people with roles, lines and routines
Standalone walkable preview page with deck-by-deck cameras
items.evidence: src/vehicles/yachts/preview.html (orbit and fixed cameras only, no walk mode yet)
